t.For example, Halima in Kano has a client: Fún àpẹrẹ, Halima ní Kano ní oníbàárà kan tí a fọwọ́ sí ní aago mẹ́wàá òwúrọ̀ fún àwọn ọ̀já ọ̀já abọ́ọ́rọ́pọ̀ sí àárín ẹhin. O fẹ lati mọ igba ti o le mu onibara ti o tẹle.

t.Cornrows are braids made flat against th: Awọn agbado jẹ braids ti a ṣe ni pẹtẹlẹ si awọ-ori. Ní Nàìjíríà ni wọ́n sábà máa ń pè wọ́n ní Shuku nígbà tí wọ́n bá péjọ sí òkè, tàbí gbogbo ẹ̀yìn nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń sáré láti iwájú lọ sí ọ̀tẹ̀. Wọn jẹ ọgbọn ipilẹ fun ọpọlọpọ awọn aza miiran, pẹlu awọn aṣọ wiwu ati diẹ ninu awọn wigi, nitorinaa gbigba wọn ni afinju ati itunu jẹ tọ adaṣe titi yoo fi rilara adayeba.

t.Cornrows are a core skill: neat parts an: Awọn agbado jẹ ọgbọn mojuto: awọn ẹya afinju ati awọn ọwọ iduro ṣe pataki ju iyara lọ ni akọkọ.
t.A cornrow is a three-strand braid. In th: Agbado jẹ braid oni-okun mẹta. Ni ọna abẹlẹ, o kọja awọn okun ita labẹ okun aarin ni igba kọọkan. Eyi jẹ ki braid duro lori oke ti awọ-ori, eyiti o jẹ oju-ọgbẹ agbado Ayebaye. Ni awọn overhand ọna, o rekoja lori arin, ati awọn braid da ipọnni ati ki o wulẹ bi a French braid. t.Hair should be clean, detangled, moistur: Irun yẹ ki o jẹ mimọ, ditangle, tutu ati ki o nà.
t.Have a rat-tail comb, clips, spray bottl: Ni comb iru eku, awọn agekuru, igo fun sokiri ati jeli ina tabi ipara braiding fun mimu.
t.Seat the client so her head is at your c: Joko onibara ki ori rẹ wa ni giga àyà rẹ. Lilọ fun awọn wakati ṣe ipalara fun ẹhin rẹ o jẹ ki awọn ori ila rẹ ko dogba.
t.Decide the number of rows. For a beginne: Ṣe ipinnu nọmba awọn ori ila. Fun aṣa alakọbẹrẹ gbogbo-pada, awọn ori ila 8 si 12 jẹ iṣakoso.
t.With the tail of the comb, part a straig: Pẹlu iru ti comb, pin laini taara lati ori irun iwaju si nape. Apa kan ila keji ni afiwe si o, awọn iwọn ti o fẹ kana. Ge irun iyokù kuro.
t.Apply a little gel or cream along the ro: Waye jeli tabi ipara diẹ ni ọna lati ṣakoso frizz ki o si fun ni mimu.
t.At the hairline, take a small piece of h: Ni irun ori, mu irun kekere kan ki o pin si awọn ila mẹta ti o dọgba: osi, arin ati ọtun.

t.Before each next cross, use your index f: Ṣaaju agbelebu kọọkan ti o tẹle, lo ika itọka rẹ lati gbe iye kekere ti irun alaimuṣinṣin lati ori ila ti o kan lẹgbẹẹ okun, ki o si fi kun si okun ita naa. Lẹhinna sọdá rẹ labẹ arin.
t.Keep your hands close to the scalp and m: Jeki ọwọ rẹ sunmọ ori awọ-ori ki o gbe ni ọna ila, fifi irun kun ni akoko kọọkan, titi iwọ o fi de nape naa.
t.When there is no more loose hair to pick: Nigbati ko ba si irun alaimuṣinṣin diẹ sii lati gbe soke, tẹsiwaju deede braid-okun mẹta si awọn opin ati ni aabo pẹlu ẹgbẹ kekere tabi nipa yiyi awọn opin.

Fa lile julọ ni arin ori ati ki o rọra ni irun ori ati awọn ile-isin oriṣa, nibiti irun ti dara julọ. Awọn onimọ-jinlẹ kilọ pe iselona wiwọ leralera le ja si alopecia isunki, pipadanu irun lati fifa nigbagbogbo, eyiti o le di ayeraye ti o ba tẹsiwaju fun awọn ọdun.

t.For example, Esther in Ibadan is practis: Fun apẹẹrẹ, Esther ni Ilu Ibadan n ṣe adaṣe fun arabinrin aburo rẹ, ti irun ori rẹ jẹ bii 25 cm lati eti si eti kọja iwaju.

t.Common beginner problems and fixes: Awọn iṣoro olubere ti o wọpọ ati awọn atunṣe

t.Pick up smaller, equal amounts; check th: Gbe soke kere, dogba iye; ṣayẹwo awọn ila apakan akọkọ
t.Gaps or loops under the braid: Awọn ela tabi awọn iyipo labẹ braid
t.Hands moving away from the scalp: Ọwọ gbigbe kuro lati awọn scalp

t.A training mannequin head with afro-text: Ori mannequin ikẹkọ pẹlu irun ifojuri afro jẹ ki o ṣe adaṣe pipin ati ẹdọfu laisi tirẹ eniyan gidi kan. Dimole si tabili kan ni giga àyà ati adaṣe fun ọgbọn iṣẹju ni ọjọ kan.
t.When the full style is done, check that: Nigbati aṣa kikun ba ti ṣe, ṣayẹwo pe awọn apakan wa ni taara, awọn ori ila jẹ iwọn kanna ni ẹgbẹ mejeeji, awọn egbegbe ko fa, ati awọn opin wa ni aabo. Di digi ọwọ kan ki alabara le rii ẹhin, ki o beere boya ori ila kan ba ni rilara.
t.Most cornrows are underhand: outer stran: Pupọ awọn agbado wa labẹ ọwọ: awọn okun ita kọja labẹ aarin
t.Add a small, equal amount of hair on eve: Fi irun kekere kan kun, iye to dọgba lori gbogbo agbelebu fun ila kan

t.Braid all rows underhand, timing each ro: Braid gbogbo awọn ori ila labẹ ọwọ, akoko ila kọọkan.

t.Make two-strand twists on natural hair: Ṣe awọn iyipo-okun meji lori irun adayeba

t.Twists and box braids are among the most: Twists ati awọn braids apoti wa laarin awọn aza aabo ti o beere julọ. t.Box braids are three-strand braids that: Awọn braids apoti jẹ awọn braids-okun mẹta ti o rọra larọwọto, pẹlu awọn ẹya onigun mẹrin tabi onigun. t.Take a piece of extension hair in propor: Mu nkan ti irun itẹsiwaju ni iwọn si apakan. Itẹsiwaju pupọ lori apakan kekere kan fa ati pe o le ba gbongbo jẹ.
t.For a classic box braid, fold the extens: Fun braid apoti Ayebaye, ṣe agbo itẹsiwaju ni ayika ipilẹ ti irun onibara ati braid awọn okun mẹta, ti o jẹ ki irun rẹ dapọ si meji ninu wọn. Fun knotless, bẹrẹ braiding irun ara rẹ fun meji tabi mẹta stitches, ki o si ifunni ni kekere awọn ege itẹsiwaju.
t.Braid down to the length wanted with eve: Braid si isalẹ lati awọn ipari fẹ pẹlu ani ẹdọfu.
t.Seal the ends: carefully dip synthetic e: Di awọn ipari: farabalẹ tẹ awọn opin sintetiki sinu omi gbona lati ekan iduroṣinṣin, lẹhinna pa pẹlu aṣọ inura kan. Diẹ ninu awọn okun nilo ẹgbẹ kan tabi lilọ dipo.
t.Improving one thing at a time is faster: Imudara ohun kan ni akoko kan yiyara ju igbiyanju lati ṣatunṣe ohun gbogbo ni ẹẹkan.

t.All braids the same thickness from front: Gbogbo braids sisanra kanna lati iwaju si ẹhin

t.Worked example: improving parts over thr: Apeere ṣiṣẹ: imudarasi awọn ẹya lori awọn akoko mẹta
t.For example, Rukayat in Abeokuta practis: Fun apere, Rukayat ni Abeokuta nse agbedemeji apoti braids lori rẹ ibatan gbogbo Sunday ati ki o maaki kọọkan igba pẹlu awọn tabili loke.

t.Before session 2 she practises parting o: Ṣaaju ki o to akoko 2 o ṣe adaṣe ipinya nikan lori mannequin fun iṣẹju 20 ni ọjọ kan o lo adari fun laini akọkọ.
t.Session 2: parts score 4, size 3, comfor: Ikoni 2: awọn apakan Dimegilio 4, iwọn 3, itunu 4, pari 3, akoko 5 wakati 30 iṣẹju. Idojukọ rẹ atẹle jẹ iwọn braid.
t.She cuts and weighs extension pieces bef: O ge ati iwuwo awọn ege itẹsiwaju ṣaaju ki o to bẹrẹ nitorina braid kọọkan gba iye kanna.
